results.description: Use recent change in dictionary-based positive word count (fnd91_sentiment2_0) to capture momentum in filing sentiment. Applied SUGGESTION1 by using a high-coverage sentiment field; SUGGESTION2 not applicable (field scalar); SUGGESTION3 not needed (coverage 0.8664>0.6); SUGGESTION4 applied (high userCount 6, alphaCount 8). Confidence set to 0.65 because sentiment momentum often predicts short-term moves but noisy.

Identify abrupt increases in dictionary-based negative words (fnd91_sentiment2_1) to short stocks on bad news. SUGGESTION1 used single strong datafield; SUGGESTION3 not needed (coverage 0.8664). SUGGESTION4 low userCount but field historically meaningful. Confidence 0.6.

Stocks with high negative sentiment relative to readability (more negatives in easier text) may underperform. Used two fields per SUGGESTION1: fnd91_sentiment2_1 and fnd91_readability_0. Both high coverage so no backfill. SUGGESTION4: readability has multiple alphas. Confidence 0.62.

Low complexity (fnd91_sentiment2_3 complexity score) combined with positive sentiment predicts outperformance. SUGGESTION1 used two complementary fields; coverage high so no ts_backfill. SUGGESTION4 moderate userCount. Confidence 0.58.
Companies whose filings become more readable (fnd91_readability_0 decreases) may signal clarity and good prospects. Single high-coverage field; SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.55.

High exposure to Topic 4 (fnd91_topic_4) combined with rising positive sentiment (fnd91_sentiment2_0) yields long bias in that topic. Applied SUGGESTION1 to combine topic and sentiment; both fields have good coverage and user/alpha counts (topic_4 userCount 9, alphaCount 20). Confidence 0.7.
Use recent increase in Topic 13 exposure (fnd91_topic_13) to capture flows into theme. Topic_13 has good coverage and alphas. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.6.
Extremes in Topic 12 exposure (fnd91_topic_12) revert cross-sectionally. SUGGESTION1 used single topic field with good coverage (0.8487). Confidence 0.58.
Large increase in numeric figures (fnd91_numeric_count) signals detailed disclosure (earnings guidance or problems). Used high-coverage numeric_count as a single predictor. Confidence 0.52.
Spike in number of attached documents (fnd91_doccount) vs historical average indicates material event. SUGGESTION1 single field with decent coverage. Confidence 0.5.

High count of long words per filing (fnd91_measure_3) normalized by sentence count indicates obfuscation. SUGGESTION1 used two measure fields (measure_3 and measure_0), both high coverage. Confidence 0.56.
Sudden rise in syllables (fnd91_measure_1) may indicate verbose management narratives hiding issues. Single high-coverage field used. Confidence 0.48.
Cross-sectional rank of negative sentiment (fnd91_sentiment1_5) to short top decile. Used high-coverage sentiment model 2 negative score. SUGGESTION4 applied (userCount 2). Confidence 0.63.
High objective (fnd91_sentiment1_3) relative to negative (fnd91_sentiment1_5) may indicate guarded language—short signal. Both fields high coverage. Confidence 0.54.

Stocks with high exposure to Topic 18 (fnd91_topic_18) and low exposure to Topic 7 may be in niche themes that outperform when topic18 rises. Used two topic fields with decent user/alpha counts (topic_18 user 10). Confidence 0.59.

Use ts_ir on positive sentiment (fnd91_sentiment2_0) to find persistent sentiment producers. SUGGESTION1 uses a robust operator ts_ir to measure signal stability. Coverage high so no backfill. Confidence 0.66.
Low readability (complex text) with many numeric figures (fnd91_numeric_count) may indicate detailed but complex disclosures—long if clarity increases. Used two fields. Confidence 0.53.
Multiply topic exposure (fnd91_topic_4) by average sentiment (fnd91_sentiment2_0) to emphasize bullish themes. SUGGESTION1 applied; both fields high coverage. Confidence 0.68.
Cross-sectional zscore of topic_10 (fnd91_topic_10) to capture reversals in attention. Field coverage 0.8007, included. Confidence 0.55.
Long stocks where Topic 13 rises faster than Topic 4 (ts_delta diff). Uses two topic fields per SUGGESTION1. Confidence 0.6.
Measure change in readability compared to same quarter last year using available metric (if mapping valid). SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.45 because seasonal effects weak.
Large ts_max_diff on topic_2 (fnd91_topic_2) signals a fresh thematic shift. Topic_2 has good coverage. Confidence 0.57.
High cross-sectional dispersion in negative sentiment (fnd91_sentiment1_5) indicates idiosyncratic risk—short extremes. SUGGESTION1 uses single field with high coverage. Confidence 0.49.
Topic_13 exposure paired with low readability (complexity) suggests opaque thematic risk. Used two fields. Confidence 0.6.
Second derivative style: change in sentiment delta for fnd91_sentiment2_0 to detect accelerating sentiment moves. Single field used. Confidence 0.61.
High exposure to single topic (topic_19) relative to other topics can indicate concentration—use topic_19 directly. SUGGESTION4: topic_19 has 1 user/alpha but coverage good. Confidence 0.47.
Divide sentiment zscore by topic volatility (ts_std_dev of topic_4) to prefer sentiment signals when topic is stable. Two fields used. Confidence 0.64.
Use ts_regression slope of topic_13 vs topic_4 (lookback d=60) to find leaders. SUGGESTION1 uses two topics. Confidence 0.58.
Large increase in complexity (fnd91_sentiment2_3) often precedes negative returns; use zscore to flag extremes. SUGGESTION1 single field. Confidence 0.52.

High ts_ir of positive sentiment (fnd91_sentiment1_4) within stocks highly exposed to a topic (topic_4) to pick persistent winners. Two fields but implementation uses sentiment IR multiplied by topic. Confidence 0.67.

Long top decile by positive sentiment (fnd91_sentiment2_0) and short bottom decile by negative (fnd91_sentiment2_1); cross-sectional ranking. SUGGESTION1 uses multiple sentiment fields. Confidence 0.65.
Only trade topic momentum when readability improves (less complex), combining ts_delta(topic_13) with reverse(ts_delta(readability)). SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Confidence 0.6.

Use similarity metric on CAT0 (fnd91_cat0_metric0_0) compared to last quarter—low similarity (novel content) predicts reaction. Metric has coverage 0.6455 and limited userCount; SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.5.

For lower coverage CAT1 metrics (fnd91_cat1_metric0_0 coverage 0.6015) we use ts_backfill per SUGGESTION3 to improve coverage and then measure zscore. SUGGESTION4: field has userCount 3. Confidence 0.54.
Focus on negative words in CAT0 (fnd91_cat0_sentiment2_1) to isolate section-specific risk. Coverage ~0.6555 so ok. SUGGESTION1 uses targeted section. Confidence 0.56.
High topic_4 exposure with many numeric figures could indicate material quantitative disclosure—use fnd91_topic_4 and fnd91_numeric_count. Both high coverage and userCount. Confidence 0.61.
Normalize positive sentiment (fnd91_sentiment2_0) by sentence count (fnd91_measure_0) to prefer concise positive filings. Both high coverage. Confidence 0.57.
Use ts_corr(topic_13, topic_4, 90) to find topics that lead others; long leaders. Two fields with good coverage. Confidence 0.59.
Rising share of complex words (fnd91_measure_2) suggests obfuscation—short signal. High coverage. Confidence 0.5.
Compute cross-sectional zscore of topic_16 (fnd91_topic_16) to detect outliers that revert. Topic_16 has decent coverage. Confidence 0.52.
If positive sentiment (fnd91_sentiment2_0) rises but readability worsens, prefer caution (short). Implemented using two fields; both high coverage. Confidence 0.55.
Long stocks where normalized topic_14 exposure exceeds topic_10 exposure. Used two topic fields with good coverage. Confidence 0.58.
Use ts_rank on fnd91_sentiment1_6 to pick recent high ranks indicating persistent positivity. SUGGESTION2 not applicable. Confidence 0.6.
Downweight sentiment signals when topic volatility high using divide by ts_std_dev(topic_13). Two fields used; both have decent counts. Confidence 0.63.
Weight sentiment by document count (fnd91_doccount) to emphasize filings with more attachments. Two fields used; both high coverage. Confidence 0.51.
Use ts_arg_min(topic_4, 30) to detect recent bottoms in topic attention that may signal negative developments. Single topic field used. Confidence 0.46.
Favor stocks with co-exposure to topic_13 and topic_4 by multiplying exposures—captures combined theme strength. Two fields used. Confidence 0.6.
Apply ts_decay_linear on positive sentiment (fnd91_sentiment2_0) to capture recent weight. Single field used with ts_decay_linear. Confidence 0.62.
Cross-sectional zscore of topic_8 (fnd91_topic_8) to capture over/under-exposure. Topic_8 coverage 0.786. Confidence 0.54.
Positive sentiment per sentence (fnd91_sentiment2_0 / fnd91_measure_0) favors concise positive messages. Two high-coverage fields used. Confidence 0.58.
Use ts_delta(topic_18, 7) zscored to detect rising attention in topic_18 which historically had user interest. Field has userCount 10. Confidence 0.66.
Extreme high readability (too simple) sometimes signals boilerplate; use reverse zscore on fnd91_readability_2. Field high coverage. Confidence 0.44.
Multiply topic exposure by numeric_count to prioritize filings with topic mention and data. Two fields used. Confidence 0.6.
Winsorize sentiment to reduce outliers then cross-sectional zscore on fnd91_sentiment1_2. Applied SUGGESTION1 and winsorize for robustness. Confidence 0.61.
Compute ts_count_nans on topic_13 to measure coverage persistence; prefer topics with consistent exposures. Single field transformed. Confidence 0.5.

If a vector sentiment field existed we'd use vec_avg; here we emulate by averaging model1 and model2 positive (fnd91_sentiment1_1 + fnd91_sentiment1_4)/2. SUGGESTION2 partially applied conceptually; used two fields only. Confidence 0.56.
Use ts_arg_max(topic_4, 20) to find recent local maxima for short signals. Single field. Confidence 0.48.
Zscore difference between sentiment2_0 and readability_0 to spot mismatches. Two fields used, high coverage. Confidence 0.59.
Pick stocks with positive ts_returns in topic_14 (ts_returns of fnd91_topic_14) capturing rising attention. Single field. Confidence 0.53.
Compare CAT0 negative score (fnd91_cat0_sentiment2_1) with filing-level negative (fnd91_sentiment2_1) to detect section-specific issues. Two fields used. Confidence 0.57.
Use tail operator to cap extreme topic_13 exposures before ranking (reduce turnover). Single field with tail. Confidence 0.55.
High ts_kurtosis of sentiment (fnd91_sentiment2_0) indicates fat tails; avoid extremes. Single field used. Confidence 0.5.
Favor topic_13 exposure when readability improves (less complex): multiply topic_13 by reverse(readability_0). Two fields used. Confidence 0.6.
ts_zscore of sentence count delta (fnd91_measure_0) to find filings with sudden narrative expansion. Single field. Confidence 0.49.
Use quantile on topic_11 exposure to pick over/under-exposed names. Field has good coverage. Confidence 0.46.

results.idea: Topic momentum scaled by document count
results.description: Scale ts_delta(topic_4) by doccount to emphasize substantial filings. Two fields used and both high coverage. Confidence 0.62.
Average positive scores across sentiment models (fnd91_sentiment1_1 and fnd91_sentiment1_4) to reduce idiosyncratic model noise. Two fields used. Confidence 0.64.
Subtract topic_7 from topic_2 exposures to find theme shifts. Two topic fields used. Confidence 0.5.
Prefer topic momentum when complexity decreases (reverse fnd91_sentiment2_3). Two fields used. Confidence 0.58.
Use ts_product(topic_10, 5) to detect sustained attention across filings. Single field. Confidence 0.47.
Second derivative of negative sentiment (fnd91_sentiment2_1) to detect accelerating negativity. Single field used. Confidence 0.6.
Multiply topic_13 by inverse of complexity (1/(1+fnd91_sentiment2_3)) to favor clear-topic filings. Two fields used; no backfill required. Confidence 0.6.
Use zscore(readability_0) cross-sectionally to pick unusually clear filings. Single high-coverage field. Confidence 0.5.
High topic_12 with low numeric_count may signal qualitative narratives—short/long depending on theme. Two fields used. Confidence 0.46.
Coverage of fnd91_cat12_metric1_0 is 0.5082 (<0.6) so apply ts_backfill per SUGGESTION3 before using ts_zscore. SUGGESTION4 not applicable. Confidence 0.42.
Use ts_rank(topic_13, 10) to capture recent acceleration in thematic exposure. Single field. Confidence 0.55.
Multiply ts_ir(fnd91_sentiment2_0,90) by topic_18 to prioritize persistent sentiment within this topic. Two fields used; topic_18 has strong user interest. Confidence 0.68.
Use bucket(rank(topic_16)) to create exposure buckets and long top bucket. Single field bucketed. Confidence 0.49.
Zscore of long-words count (fnd91_measure_3) cross-sectionally to detect outliers. Single field high coverage. Confidence 0.47.
Compare topic_4 to same quarter last year via ts_delta 252 to find structural increases. Single field. Confidence 0.53.
Winsorize positive and negative sentiment then take difference to reduce outlier risk (winsorize on fnd91_sentiment2_0 and fnd91_sentiment2_1). SUGGESTION1 applied. Confidence 0.6.
Use ts_arg_max(topic_13, 20)==0 (current day max) as breakout filter. Single field. Confidence 0.51.
Large changes in category-specific word counts (e.g., fnd91_cat13_cnt0) can flag events; coverage 0.6578 so safe. SUGGESTION1 used sectional data. Confidence 0.48.
Divide topic_4 exposure by its ts_std_dev to prefer stable exposures. Single field transformation. Confidence 0.6.
Stocks with sudden worsening readability (increase in fnd91_readability_0) may underperform; using ts_delta. Confidence 0.52.
Multiply topic_14 by positive sentiment (fnd91_sentiment2_0) to find theme-supported bullish names. Two fields used. Confidence 0.59.
fnd91_cat11_cnt4 (coverage 0.6446) sudden spikes may indicate section-specific narrative changes; use ts_delta. SUGGESTION3 not required. Confidence 0.45.
Normalize ts_delta(topic_13) by its ts_mean to capture relative growth. Single field. Confidence 0.56.
Only act on sentiment momentum if doccount above median (fnd91_doccount). Two fields used; high coverage. Confidence 0.6.
Spread topic_8 minus topic_3 exposures to identify shifting attention between related themes. Two fields used. Confidence 0.5.
Long names with low complexity (low fnd91_sentiment2_3) and positive sentiment; multiply inverse complexity by sentiment2_0. Two fields used. Confidence 0.62.
Prefer topic_7 signals only when its ts_std_dev over 60 days is below median (stable theme). Single field transformed. Confidence 0.48.
High disagreement between sentiment models (abs difference fnd91_sentiment1_1 - fnd91_sentiment1_4) signals uncertainty; avoid extremes. Two fields used. Confidence 0.53.
Cross-sectional zscore of ts_delta(topic_18,7) to capture rapid increases in theme attention. Topic_18 has userCount 10. Confidence 0.67.
Cap extreme topic_4 values with tail and then zscore to avoid outlier-driven positions. Single field used with two operators. Confidence 0.59.
Apply signed_power to sentiment2_0 to accentuate strong signals and preserve sign. Single field used. Confidence 0.6.
Winsorize ts_delta(topic_13) before zscore to reduce outlier influence. Single field. Confidence 0.56.
fnd91_cat5_metric0_1 has coverage 0.551 (<0.6) so apply ts_backfill per SUGGESTION3 then ts_zscore. Field has userCount 2. Confidence 0.44.
Compute ratio topic_13 / topic_4 to find names dominated by one theme. Two fields used. Confidence 0.5.
Rank recent sentiment (ts_rank fnd91_sentiment2_0) to capture persistent positive narratives. Single field. Confidence 0.6.
Use ts_ir(topic_4, 252) to find topics with high information ratio over a year. Single field. Confidence 0.57.
Multiply reverse(readability_0) with ts_delta(topic_13) to prefer clear thematic momentum. Two fields. Confidence 0.61.
Winsorize topic_13 then apply reverse quantile to capture mean reversion. Single field. Confidence 0.53.
Only take sentiment momentum if long-word count (measure_3) decreases (less obfuscation). Two fields used. Confidence 0.59.
Quantile rank of topic_18 exposure to long top decile. Topic_18 has notable user interest. Confidence 0.64.
Flag stocks where category-level negative (fnd91_cat0_sentiment2_1) exceeds filing-level negative (fnd91_sentiment2_1). Two fields used. Confidence 0.55.
Apply tail to limit extreme topic_4 values then measure ts_zscore of delta for momentum. Single field with two operators. Confidence 0.6.
Compute information ratio of readability (fnd91_readability_0) to find consistently improving disclosure patterns. Single field. Confidence 0.46.
ts_delta(topic_13, 63) (approx quarter) to capture medium-term thematic shifts. Single field. Confidence 0.52.
Use fnd91_cat13_metric0_1 (coverage 0.6483) ts_delta then zscore to capture section metric momentum. SUGGESTION4 used (field has userCount 2). Confidence 0.5.

results.idea: Topic 4 normalized by group size proxy (doccount)
results.description: Divide topic_4 by doccount to prefer strong theme mentions in substantive filings. Two fields used. Confidence 0.58.
If ts_delta of sentiment2_0 flips sign quickly (ts_arg_min/max within short window), flag reversal. Single field. Confidence 0.6.
Multiply zscored topic_13 by positive sentiment to prioritize salient, positively discussed themes. Two fields used. Confidence 0.63.
Avoid sentiment trades when sentence count (fnd91_measure_0) is highly volatile (ts_std_dev large). Two fields logic used. Confidence 0.54.
Use ts_decay_linear on topic_13 to emphasize recent increases. Single field operator. Confidence 0.57.
Low similarity to last year's filing in CAT0 (fnd91_cat0_metric1_0 coverage 0.5864) - apply ts_backfill per SUGGESTION3 then reverse zscore (novelty). Confidence 0.43.
Add exposures to topic_4 and topic_13 to capture combined attention. Two fields and add operator used. Confidence 0.58.
Subtract scaled negative sentiment from topic momentum (ts_zscore(ts_delta(topic_13)) - neg sentiment) to avoid topics with rising negativity. Two fields. Confidence 0.62.

Emulate vec_avg by averaging several topic exposures (topic_4 and topic_13) to create a theme index while keeping 2-field limit. SUGGESTION2 noted but vector not available; used 2 fields. Confidence 0.55.
